summary: Verified bug fix for student college-ID verify + approval-blocked-by-verification. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass (verify only affects one member, approve blocked when unverified, approve succeeds when verified, request-reupload clears url+verified, verify fails without college_id_url). Frontend: verify-id modal renders correctly (student name, uploaded image, Request Re-upload / Cancel / Verify ID buttons); after verifying one student only that row switches to 'ID Verified' while others remain 'ID Pending' (proves state update is scoped to single member, no full reload/bug regression); approve button on unverified pending student is greyed out (opacity 0.6, cursor not-allowed, title='Verify college ID first') and clicking it triggers a client-side guard toast 'Verify student college ID before approving' rather than hitting the API.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 5928: request-reupload-college-id does not check membership_type. Non-student members can also have their college_id_url cleared. Low risk since non-students never have this field, but worth a guard for defensive coding.
MembersAdmin.jsx line 275: approve button uses onClick guard (isStudentUnverified) instead of the native `disabled` attribute. Works functionally but not fully a11y-friendly for screen readers.

MembersAdmin.jsx handleAction (line 90-96): still calls load() on approve/reject/hold which triggers a full data reload — only verify-id/request-reupload use scoped local state updates. Consider extending scoped updates to other actions for consistency.
seed_data_creation: Created 3 UITEST_Student{X,Y,Z} student members via POST /api/admin/members for UI verification. All deleted at end of run. Pre-existing 'Test Student A/B/C' seed rows were used to verify the pending+unverified approve-button-disabled state (Test Student B).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verify-college-id and approval-guard bug fix confirmed working both backend + frontend. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_student_verify_approve.py is a good regression harness. Note: POST /api/admin/members creates student members with status=approved by default (not pending) — so to test approve-blocked flow via UI use Test Student B seed which is intentionally pending+unverified. Auth endpoint is POST /api/auth/login (not /api/admin/login).
rca of the issue: Original bug: (1) verify endpoint bulk-updated all students, (2) approve endpoint didn't check verification. Fixes verified: (1) /verify-college-id uses `update_one({"id": member_id}, ...)` and returns matched=1/modified=1; independent members remain unverified. (2) /approve raises 400 with detail 'Cannot approve: Student's college ID must be verified first' when membership_type is student/students_membership AND college_id_url set AND college_id_verified false. Frontend also updates only the single row's college_id_verified in local `members` state instead of doing full load(), preventing UI ambiguity.
